reasoning: The icon depicts a standard download symbol (downward arrow into a tray) crossed out by a diagonal slash, meaning download disabled, blocked, or offline downloads removed. Because the slash heavily fragments the arrow head into tiny disconnected triangles, it is somewhat hard to read at small sizes and fits only a narrow set of tech/settings tasks around stopping auto-downloads or restricting file downloads.

pass1.ambiguity: At small sizes, the slashed arrow and tray break into small disconnected fragments that can look like an abstract geometric logo or a broken upload/export icon.

distinguishing: Shows a downward-pointing arrow into a tray crossed out by a diagonal slash (representing disabled or blocked downloads), whereas the look-alike has an upward-pointing arrowhead above the slash for disabled uploads.
